target_definition.SAFE_TO_EXECUTE: eventually clears after t1 and no D1 core adverse/control signal occurs after t1
target_definition.NOT_SAFE_TO_EXECUTE: at least one D1 core adverse/control signal occurs after t1

split_policy: Reuse the already-frozen source-case split assignments from rcse_experimental_with_splits.parquet.
architectural_boundary: The post-GATHER estimator predicts P(SAFE_TO_EXECUTE | O_t1) without transaction exposure/risk stratum or post-t1 outcome features. Consequence is added only later in the RCSE decision layer.
next_step: If discrimination and calibration are adequate, freeze q_t1 prediction artifacts and implement the RCSE/VoI decision policy.
